correctness.rationale: Every geometric fixed point is uniquely represented by barycenters of compatible full weight orbits. Exact Hamming maxima give the bipartite band incompatibility graph. Explicit neighborhood inclusions yield simplicial collapses to the join of d+1 zero-spheres. The induced bucket retractions map each old cross-polytope fundamental cycle onto the new generator exactly when degree stays constant, giving complete integral barcodes. The all-parameter proof handles n >= 2, r < n and contractible r >= n; finite face/homology checks corroborate without being substituted.

value.rationale: The full coordinate-symmetry fixed locus is a naturally motivated equivariant object. Uniform sphere dimensions and all integer persistence maps reveal arbitrarily long degree-one intervals, contrasting sharply with Adams-Virk nullhomotopic ambient inclusions. The result is an infinite all-scale integral classification with reproducible explicit collapses, not a routine finite invariant.
